title: What are the subject titles, their material titles, ISBN numbers, and total
question: What are the subject titles, their material titles, ISBN numbers, and total costs of new materials for each subject title?

access_trace.sql:
SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.TITLE AS material_title, m.ISBN, SUM(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_cost
FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s
JOIN TIP_DETAIL d ON d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL m ON m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.TITLE, m.ISBN
LIMIT 20;
